name: webmcp
description: Get a website ready for AI agents with WebMCP: audit agent-readiness, propose page tools, implement them on document.modelContext, and verify them in a real browser.

interface.shortDescription: Get a website ready for AI agents with WebMCP
interface.longDescription: Guides an agent to audit a web app for agent-readiness, propose non-overlapping page tools with the developer, implement them on the standard document.modelContext API (declarative forms, imperative registerTool, or a bridge to an existing MCP server), and verify every tool in a real browser.
defaultPrompt: Audit this website's agent-readiness and propose WebMCP tools.
Make this app WebMCP-compatible and verify the tools in a browser.
